## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō fùzhōng nǚ tīng jīng* (T563) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by the famous Northern Liáng translator Tánwúchèn 曇無讖 ([曇無讖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%AE%96); Dharmakṣema, 385–433 CE). The protagonist is a maiden who, while still in the womb, hears and understands the Buddha's teaching — a miraculous demonstration of pre-natal bodhisattva-development.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text on a remarkable child-bodhisattva. Tánwúchèn's translation activity at the Northern Liáng court of Júqú Méngsùn 沮渠蒙遜 is dated 414–433 CE; this text falls within that bracket.
